source_signature.notes: Batch 4G skill 2/5. Scope Operator-derived. The load-shear-moment relationship node: owns the differential relations dV/dx = -w and dM/dx = V and their area forms (ΔV = -area under w; ΔM = area under V), plus the consequences (V=0 -> M local extremum; concentrated load -> V jump; couple -> M jump; unloaded span V constant M linear; uniform load V linear M parabolic). Boundary INVERTED from skills 1/shear: bending_moment_internal_loading and shear_force_internal_loading find V and M at ONE cut by section equilibrium and excluded the differential relations; THIS skill owns those relations and cites the siblings for point values. It is NOT the diagrams (shear_moment_diagram_construction, downstream skill 3) and NOT the numeric global max moment (maximum_moment_from_zero_shear, skill 4); both are named and ceded. Worked example Operator-re-derived: 6 m simply-supported beam, uniform w=4 kN/m, Ay=By=12, V(0+)=12. dV/dx = -w = -4 kN/m (the minus is load-bearing: downward w gives decreasing shear; +4 would reverse the sense and misplace the extremum). ΔV = -area under w = -(4)(6) = -24 kN, checked V(6-)=12-24=-12. V(x)=12-4x, V=0 at x=3 m, where dM/dx=V=0 so M has a local extremum - and the example states the extremum is NOT at max|w| or max|V| (which are at the ends), the exact misconception the skill owns. All deliverables are local/span relation applications; no full diagram drawn, no numeric M_max computed. TWO-signal mapping: sign_or_placement_error at step 3 (the dV/dx=-w sign and the V=0 extremum placement - the skill's crux), unclassified at step 6 (the diagram/max-moment boundary). axis_confusion OMITTED: a calculus-relation skill, no component-resolution step. solution_sequencing_error OMITTED although the w->V->M integration has a natural order and this was the batch skill where it could plausibly be earned: considered honestly and declined - no authored step exposes an out-of-order solve that strands a prerequisite unknown with direct evidence; the example applies the relations in order without a sequencing trap. The fifth signal is mapped only where an authored step earns it, not defaulted because integration has an order. simple_average_used omitted (Centroids-family). Unlocks shear_moment_diagram_construction (skill 3).
